summary: init wiring tests. The '/repair-aliases command (retired)' block checks USER_COMMANDS no longer contains it and that removeRetiredCommand deletes the old Claude/Cursor/Codex files and the emptied skill dir, and tolerates absent files. The Codex and Cursor wiring tests also pin the compaction hook: Codex gets recall-compact.mjs on PostCompact and must have NO PreCompact entry, Cursor gets it on preCompact, and re-init leaves exactly one PostCompact entry.
